name: Ashen Band of Courage
reqAttune: by a Character with Ashen Verdict Renown 3+
entries: This metal band is adorned with five gleaming crystals suggesting a beast's claw. The forge mark of Ormus the Penitent—a stylized O—is imprinted inside the band.
While wearing this ring, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws to avoid or end the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} and {@condition Frightened|XPHB} conditions.

name: Ashen Band of Destruction
reqAttune: by a Character with Ashen Verdict Renown 3+
entries: This thick metal band is adorned with a skull design, with two luminous blue gems serving as eyes. The forge mark of Ormus the Penitent—a stylized O—is imprinted inside the band.
While wearing this ring, you gain a +1 bonus to spell attack rolls, and your spell saving throw DC increases by 1.

name: Ashen Band of Endless Courage

entries.items: While wearing this ring, you have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} and {@condition Frightened|XPHB} conditions, and you gain a +1 bonus to {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB}. In addition, you gain a +1 bonus to saving throws.

reqAttune: by a Character with Ashen Verdict Renown 50+

name: Ashen Band of Endless Destruction

entries.items: While wearing this ring, you gain a +3 bonus to spell attack rolls, and your spell saving throw DC increases by 3, and you can treat any 1 you roll on a damage die for a spell you cast as a 2. In addition, your spellcasting ability increases by 2 (to a maximum of 30). You can also add a +3 bonus to one damage roll of each spell you cast.

reqAttune: by a Character with Ashen Verdict Renown 50+

name: Ashen Band of Endless Might

entries.items: While wearing this ring, you gain a +1 bonus to damage rolls for melee weapon attacks, and you can treat any 1 you roll on a melee weapon's damage die as a 2. In addition, your Strength is 25. This property has no effect if your Strength is 25 or higher without it.

reqAttune: by a Character with Ashen Verdict Renown 50+

name: Ashen Band of Endless Vengeance

entries.items: While wearing this ring, you ignore {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Half Cover} when making a ranged weapon attack roll, you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls made with ranged weapons, and using a ranged weapon at long range doesn't impose {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on your attack roll. In addition, you ignore {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Three-Quarters Cover} when making a ranged attack roll, and the maximum range of your ranged weapon attacks is doubled. You can treat any 1 or 2 you roll on a ranged weapon's damage die as a 3.

reqAttune: by a Character with Ashen Verdict Renown 50+

name: Ashen Band of Endless Wisdom

entries.items: While wearing this ring, you can treat any 1 you roll on a die to restore {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} to yourself or another creature as a 2. In addition, whenever an effect you create restores {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} to one creature, you can choose another creature within 30 feet of the first to also regain half that many {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} (round down). When you cast a spell with a range of touch that doesn't require an attack roll, you can increase the spell's range to 30 feet. Your spellcasting ability also increases by 2 (to a maximum of 30).

While wearing this ring, you ignore {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Half Cover} when making a ranged weapon attack roll, and you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls made with ranged weapons.

name: Ashen Band of Wisdom
reqAttune: by a Character with Ashen Verdict Renown 3+
entries: This metal band is adorned with an oval design suggestive of an eye, with a luminous turquoise stone at the center. The forge mark of Ormus the Penitent—a stylized O—is imprinted inside the band.
While wearing this ring, you can treat any 1 you roll on a die to restore {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} to yourself or another creature as a 2.

name: Bauble of True Blood
entries: The red pendant on this necklace has 9 charges and regains {@dice 1d6} expended charges daily at dawn. You can also expend {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} when you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} to replenish its charges, with each {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Die} you expend contributing 1 charge.
You can expend any number of charges to cast {@spell Cure Wounds|XPHB} from the bauble, with the number of charges determining the level of the spell (maximum of 9 charges for a level 9 spell).

name: Bloodvenom Blade
entries: You gain a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. In addition, it deals an extra {@damage 2d6} Poison damage to any creature it hits, and the creature has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition until the start of your next turn.

name: Fragment of Frozen Bone
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can use a command word to cause this tiny piece of bone from {@creature Lord Marrowgar|ICC|Lord Marrowgar's} remains to transform into a miniature replica of Lord Marrowgar called Boneshard. Boneshard serves as an undead companion creature using the rules in D&D: {@book World of Warcraft|WoW}. It remains transformed until you use the command word to dismiss it, it takes any damage, or you summon another companion creature. Occasionally it shouts, "BONE STORM!" as it circles you on the ground.

name: Invincible's Reins
entries: These reins are a heavy metal chain attached to a bridle set with glowing blue crystals. The reins have 3 charges and regain {@dice 1d3} expended charges daily at dawn. You can expend 1 charge to cast {@spell Find Steed|XPHB} (level 5 version).

When you cast {@spell Find Steed|XPHB} from the reins, the summoned steed is Invincible, the mount of {@creature Lich King Arthas|WoW|Arthas}—an Undead horse with mummified flesh, glowing blue eyes, and batlike wings. The steed has the Undead type, deals Necrotic damage with its Otherworldly Slam attack, and has this {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}:

entries.name: Ghostly Stride (Undead Only; Recharges After a Long Rest)
entries: The steed and its rider can move through other creatures and objects this turn as if they were {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}. Both steed and rider take 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Force damage if they end their turn inside an object.

Invincible is Neutral Evil and unshakably loyal to Arthas, the Lich King. Use the guidelines for conflict with sentient magic items in the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|XDMG} to determine what happens if Invincible's rider acts contrary to the mount's alignment or in opposition to the Lich King. Invincible can refuse the reins' summons in situations of conflict.

name: Light's Vengeance
entries: Light's Vengeance is the weapon Arthas Menethil wielded during his life as a paladin in service to the Order of the Silver Hand—before his corruption and transformation into the {@creature Lich King Arthas|WoW|Lich King}. An enormous and heavy hammer, its silver head etched with runes of power and its haft wrapped in blue leather, it carries the blessing of the Light. Arthas discarded the weapon when he took up {@item Frostmourne|WoW}.

entries.name: Magic Weapon
entries: You gain a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this weapon, and it deals an extra {@damage 2d10} Radiant damage to Undead.

entries.name: Repel Undead
entries: While holding the weapon, you can take the {@action Magic|XPHB} action to cause brilliant light to burst around you in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}. Each Undead in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} makes a {@dc 20} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes {@damage 4d8} Radiant damage and has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} and {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} conditions for 1 minute. While {@condition Frightened|XPHB}, a target must use its movement on each of its turns to move as far from you as it can. This effect ends early on a target if it takes any damage.

entries.name: Random Properties
entries: Though Light's Vengeance was blessed by the Light and wielded by the Light's champion, the weapon carries the stain of the Lich King's corruption. The weapon has the following random properties:

items: 2 {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Beneficial Properties|XDMG|minor beneficial} properties
1 {@table Artifact Properties; Major Beneficial Properties|XDMG|major beneficial} property
2 {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Detrimental Properties|XDMG|minor detrimental} properties

entries.name: Destroying the Weapon
entries: Striking Light's Vengeance with {@item Frostmourne|WoW} destroys the {@item maul|XPHB}.

name: Ring of Maddening Whispers
reqAttune: by a Spellcaster
entries: This ring resembles a fleshy purple tentacle banded with dark metal and suffused with a reddish glow. While wearing it, you can cast {@spell Dominate Monster|XPHB} (level 9 version) from it (spell save {@dc 19}). Once you do, you can't use the ring to do so again until the next dawn.

Whenever a creature makes a successful saving throw against the spell cast from the ring, you take {@damage 5d10} Psychic damage and have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition until the end of your next turn, as a chorus of babbling whispers assails your mind.

name: Shadow's Edge
entries: Highlord Darion Mograine of the Knights of the Ebon Blade forged Shadow's Edge in his runeforge, combining the holy power of {@item Light's Vengeance|ICC} with primordial saronite—the blood of the Old God Yogg-Saron in mineral form—and the toxic venom from two of the {@creature Lich King Arthas|WoW|Lich King's} minions. The result is a mighty axe with the potential, ultimately, to destroy the Lich King.

entries.name: Magic Weapon
entries: You gain a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this weapon.

entries.name: Drain Soul
entries: Whenever you use Shadow's Edge to reduce a creature to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, the axe slays the creature and devours its soul unless it is a Construct. A creature whose soul has been devoured by Shadow's Edge can be restored to life only by a {@spell Wish|XPHB} spell.
When Shadow's Edge devours a soul, you gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to half the slain creature's {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum (round down).

entries.name: Random Properties
entries: The weapon has the following random properties:

items: 1 {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Beneficial Properties|XDMG|minor beneficial} property
1 {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Detrimental Properties|XDMG|minor detrimental} property

entries.name: Unholy Infusion
entries: Once Shadow's Edge has been infused with {@creature Professor Putricide, Phase 1|ICC|Professor Putricide's} mutated slime, it gains the following additional random properties:

items: 1 {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Beneficial Properties|XDMG|minor beneficial} property
1 {@table Artifact Properties; Major Detrimental Properties|XDMG|major detrimental} property

entries: In addition, when you hit a creature with Shadow's Edge, you can cast {@spell Blight|XPHB} (save {@dc 19}) from it on the target as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. Once you use the weapon to cast the spell in this way, you can't do so again until the next dawn.

entries.name: Blood Infusion
entries: Once Shadow's Edge has been infused with blood from {@creature Blood-Queen Lana'thel|ICC|Lana'thel's} Blood Mirror, it gains the following additional random properties:

items: 1 {@table Artifact Properties; Major Beneficial Properties|XDMG|major beneficial} property
1 {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Detrimental Properties|XDMG|minor detrimental} property

entries: In addition, when you hit a creature with Shadow's Edge, you can cast {@spell Evard's Black Tentacles|XPHB} (save {@dc 19}) from the weapon with an area that includes the target as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. Once you use the weapon to cast the spell in this way, you can't do so again until the next dawn.

entries.name: Frost Infusion
entries: Once Shadow's Edge has been infused with frost from {@creature Sindragosa|ICC|Sindragosa's} breath, it gains the following additional random properties:

items: 1 {@table Artifact Properties; Major Beneficial Properties|XDMG|major beneficial} property
1 {@table Artifact Properties; Major Detrimental Properties|XDMG|major detrimental} property

entries: In addition, when you hit a creature with Shadow's Edge, you can cast {@spell Cone of Cold|XPHB} (save {@dc 19}) from it with an area that includes the target as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. Once you use the weapon to cast the spell in this way, you can't do so again until the next dawn.

entries.name: Destroying the Weapon
entries: The axe can be destroyed by melting it down in Highlord Mograine's runeforge, where it was created. Destroying it frees the souls it devoured.

name: Shadowmourne
entries: Highlord Darion Mograine transformed {@item Shadow's Edge|ICC} into Shadowmourne after the weapon had been infused with unholy power, blood magic, and undying frost, along with shadowfrost shards from the Frozen Throne.

entries.name: Magic Weapon
entries: You gain a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this weapon.

entries.name: Soul Fragments
entries: When you hit a creature with a melee attack roll using Shadowmourne, the creature takes an extra {@damage 1d12} Necrotic damage, and you gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the Necrotic damage taken.

entries.name: Drain Soul
entries: Whenever you use Shadowmourne to reduce a creature to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, the axe slays the creature and devours its soul unless it is a Construct. A creature whose soul has been devoured by Shadowmourne can be restored to life only by a {@spell Wish|XPHB} spell.
When Shadowmourne devours a soul, you gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the slain creature's {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum.

entries.name: Chaos Bane
entries: If you have at least 12 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to sacrifice all your {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}. Each creature of your choice in a 15-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you makes a Constitution saving throw ({@dc 21}), taking damage equal to the {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} you sacrificed on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Until the end of your next turn, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls and saving throws.

entries.name: Random Properties
entries: The weapon has the same random properties it had in its final stage as {@item Shadow's Edge|ICC}:

items: 2 {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Beneficial Properties|XDMG|minor beneficial} properties
2 {@table Artifact Properties; Major Beneficial Properties|XDMG|major beneficial} properties
2 {@table Artifact Properties; Minor Detrimental Properties|XDMG|minor detrimental} properties
2 {@table Artifact Properties; Major Detrimental Properties|XDMG|major detrimental} properties

entries.name: Destroying the Weapon
entries: The axe can be destroyed by immersing it in a pool of the fresh blood of an Old God. Destroying it frees the souls it devoured.

name: Sundial of Eternal Dusk
entries: Despite its name, a Sundial of Eternal Dusk resembles a lantern more than a sundial. A rough shard of green saronite metal hangs suspended above an iron cylinder, flanked by wings sculpted from brass. Glowing green gas billows between the saronite shard and the cylinder, and a smaller green shard bobs between two forked prongs on the bottom of the implement. A curved handle above the larger shard allows the item to be held easily in one hand. While you hold the sundial, you know what time it is.

entries.name: Spellcasting Focus
entries: You can use the sundial as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|XPHB} for your spells.

entries.name: Cloak of Shadows
entries: The sundial emits shadow that fills your space with {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB}, making the space {@variantrule Lightly Obscured|XPHB} and giving you {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Radiant damage. The shadow doesn't obscure your vision.

entries.name: Spells
entries: The sundial has 20 charges and regains {@dice 1d6 + 3} expended charges daily at dawn. While holding the sundial, you can cast one of the spells on the following table from it (save {@dc 19}). The table indicates how many charges you must expend to cast the spell.

rows: {@spell Dimension Door|XPHB} (the destination must be in {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} or {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB})

name: Thrice Fanged Signet
entries: This silver ring is adorned with a pyramid shape topped with a glowing blue crystal. The three fangs that give it its name protrude from the underside of the pyramid to pierce the wearer's finger.

When you cast a spell while wearing this ring, you can let the ring draw your blood to empower the spell. If you do, your current and maximum {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} are reduced by {@dice 3d6}, and the spell's effects are determined as if you had used a spell slot 1 level higher than the slot you used (maximum level 9).

name: Tiny Abomination in a Jar
entries: When you roll an 11 on the {@dice d20} for an attack roll while this monstrous item is on your person, you gain a Mote of Anger—a Tiny, invulnerable mote of glowing red light that orbits your head at a distance of {@dice 1d3} feet. A Mote of Anger lasts until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. Each Mote of Anger gives you a +2 bonus to damage rolls.

If you ever have four Motes of Anger at once, they erupt and fill you with rage, allowing you to make an immediate weapon attack with {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on the attack roll. The Motes of Anger grant their damage bonuses to this attack if they hit, and they dissipate after the attack whether it hits or misses.
The tiny abomination floating in this jar appears lifeless, but if you have one or more Motes of Anger, it stirs, growing increasingly animated the more Motes of Anger you have.
